notes.title: Now speaking 9 languages!
notes.content:
Game is now enjoyable in 3 new languages: Português, Italiano and Русский making it a total 8 available languages:
[list]
[*]English
[*]Español	
[*]Deutsch	
[*]Français	
[*]Português	
[*]Italiano	
[*]Slovensky
[*]Srpski	
[*]Русский	
[/list]

[b]Update:[/b] Serbian language added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31694701/127cad27954c7344811038ac0be13dfd06a4c1a9.png[/img]

Big thanks to all the translators and hopefully now almost everybody can enjoy the game :). If however you're still missing your language and you're willing to help with translation (~250 words), please contact me via steam or FB page https://www.facebook.com/bonvoyagepuzzle

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31694701/ff3d968633e15e7f691aefc143db8d8ae8477845.png[/img]

Las but not least, maybe you've missed great showcase sale of games created in former Czechoslovakia but here is a list so you can pick some nice game from my talented colleagues and friends:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/SCSsoftware/sale/CZSKGamesWeek]CZ/SK Games[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/SCSsoftware/sale/CZSKGamesWeek][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35074301/266286a84ce9f1d2e98fc607dbec35e83a4dfabf.png[/img][/url]


Happy holidays, my friends!
Boris

notes.title: Update: polish and level pack 2!
notes.content:
[h1]Polish[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/75a714967477fe1f97185cfacf9eb31b23335ed0.png[/img]

Based on the great input from players at game expo the game was polished, these parts were updated:

[list]
    [*]helper to show which ordered point is supposed to be next
    [*]better "not all required points passed" message timing
    [*]fix of editor reload pointing to scan page
    [*]level name shown while playing level
    [*]info text in level with shadow to be better readable
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/39ec034dfc2007daada69adb0dbc2699d35f204f.png[/img]

I hope this will make the gameplay more pleasant!

[h1]Level pack 2[/h1]

This time I've chosen the additive color theme so you can explore this mechanic more in the new 8 levels found in [b]Extra Levels[/b] tab, enjoy! I hope they are challenging and fun at the same time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/2d94ca106927e8c944990e041fdcd9e400676947.png[/img]

[i]Happy puzzle solving and have a nice Easter![/i]

notes.title: Free update: Level pack 1
notes.content:
Today the game was expanded with 10 new levels. You can find them at the end of [b]Extra levels[/b] tab! Levels are showing how just a slight change of rules can create interesting variations to the solution and change the overall difficulty.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/e08d19be7d0db3fbde6774eb1ffd2b6df023ad67.png[/img]

More updates like this are planned for the future. Happy puzzle solving and I hope you like it!

notes.title: Update 1.02: visual tweak and keyboard support
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Keyboard control support added
    [*]Visual tweak to easier distinguish between start/finish points
[/list]

Today I've prepared promised update.

[h1]Visual update[/h1]

First of all the visual difference between start and finish is bigger now so they should be easy to distinguish from afar. Finish is now full circle, manhole cover placed below the color visual. Start is a loop as before.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/25846e2fbf4c6ca3f20aac4bae7b7a09090f6b59.png[/img]

[h1]Keyboard support[/h1]
For those uncomfortable with dragging the cars around with your mouse keyboard support was added.

[olist]
    [*]Select the car you want to use with [i]Tab[/i] (multiple clicks cycle through available vehicles). Selected car is visualized with big color star on ground
    [*]Move the car using [i]WSAD[/i] or [i]arrows[/i] (click or hold)
    [*]Dragging any car with mouse deselects keyboard controls, can be reenabled with [i]Tab[/i]
[/olist]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/84f7951877f0ef92d2a4500cc3337ba54e812744.png[/img]

I hope you'll find this update helpful and can enjoy the puzzle solving more!

notes.title: Update 1.01, news and future plans
notes.content:
[h1]Update notes[/h1]
Today I've released a small fix for the game addressing few minor issues with achievements (e.g. [i]Grand master[/i] was not being granted).

[h1]News[/h1]
I've also glad to announce that we have first player that beat the campaign on the hard difficulty (timer and night mode)! According to Steam, the play time was around 6 hours so [i]I'm proud to say that singleplayer campaign is as long as in Call of Duty games lately ;)[/i].

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/3396635d2e7f1ae7d87e77d674178ffb36ceb0fa.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31694701/46334c9ed19a5b93fc0ee388e22c946100176294.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Future plans[/h1]
I'm listening to the feedback from people and please do continue to contact me with your opinions as I'd like to make this game better and more enjoyable for you!

In the next week I'd like to address these things that can be [b]improved or added[/b]:
[list]
    [*]More visually differentiated start/finish and required points
    [*]Enhanced readability of UI text in levels
    [*]Workshop integration as an alternative for level sharing
    [*]Keyboard/Controller support for car movement
[/list]

What do you think?
